verdict.rationale: A public GitHub repository for the SDKs exists (gh-1), and a community commenter reports that the RCLI repo is MIT-licensed. The same commenter, and another, say the core MetalRT inference engine is commercial and proprietary, so only part of the product's source is readable under an open license. missing for 10: first-party statement of the SDK repo's license, open source for the MetalRT/core inference engine, documentation of which components are open vs. closed.
